title: Missed Dose Pocket Pattern
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:medication pocket_name=* dose_taken=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(dose_taken="no",1,0))) as matched by pocket_name
| eval a_missed_dose_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_missed_dose_pct
description: Measures the percentage of blister-pack doses that end with a missed dose by blister pocket.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which blister pocket are helping or hurting blister-pack doses.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a missed dose` on `care:medication` events and summarize the hit rate by `pocket_name`.
visualization: Table of blister pocket with percentage of blister-pack doses ending with a missed dose.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often a missed dose happens for each blister pocket so you can see where blister-pack doses go smoothly or get stuck.
